signature: SUBROUTINE DLAQPS( M, N, OFFSET, NB, KB, A, LDA, JPVT, TAU, VN1,

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$

params.name: offset
params.reference: The number of rows of A that have been factorized in previous steps.

params.name: nb
params.reference: The number of columns to factorize.

params.name: kb
params.reference: The number of columns actually factorized.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix A. On exit, block `A(OFFSET+1:M,1:KB)` is the triangular factor obtained and block `A(1:OFFSET,1:N)` has been accordingly pivoted, but no factorized. The rest of the matrix, block `A(OFFSET+1:M,KB+1:N)` has been updated.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: JPVT
params.reference: `JPVT(I) = K` \<==\> Column K of the full matrix A has been permuted into position I in AP.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: The scalar factors of the elementary reflectors.

params.name: VN1
params.reference: The vector with the partial column norms.

params.name: VN2
params.reference: The vector with the exact column norms.

params.name: ldf
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array F. $\mathrm{LDF} \ge \max (1,N)$.
